purpose: Test whether scaffold-stable third-order residuals provide a transferable receptor-selection objective that is more faithful than additive selection and difficult for a strong classical local search.

objective.linear_term: min-max normalized mean singleton robust BEDROC20 across the three outer-train scaffold blocks
objective.stable_term: retain max(mean residual-risk_kappa*population_std,0) only if the positive-block fraction and minimum LCB gates pass, then min-max normalize retained terms
objective.formula: H(x)=sum_i h_i*x_i+0.25*sum_ij J_ij*x_i*x_j+0.75*sum_ijk K_ijk*x_i*x_j*x_k, evaluated under fixed cardinality k

quadratization.mapping: For each retained triplet choose an auxiliary y_ij=x_i*x_j; replace K_ijk*x_i*x_j*x_k by K_ijk*y_ij*x_k and add a sufficiently large quadratic consistency penalty.
quadratization.hardware_status: not constructed in Stage38; construction requires the support gate to pass

classical_comparators.triplet_objective_search: beam-64 forward construction followed by deterministic best-improvement one-swap local search from every retained target-size state
classical_comparators.direct_true_utility_search: the same strong search applied directly to outer-train robust BEDROC20
classical_comparators.additive_exact: exact fixed-cardinality optimization of the frozen singleton terms
classical_comparators.true_oracle: exact fixed-cardinality outer-train robust BEDROC20 optimum; reported as an upper diagnostic, not a deployable method

support_gate.decision: Authorize Stage39 exact quadratization only if retained triplets occur in at least 24 of 32 target-fold-size cells, exact triplet optimization beats the strong search in at least five cells, mean objective/utility Spearman is at least 0.6 on each target, and mean scaffold-holdout robust BEDROC20 is noninferior to both direct strong classical search and additive exact selection on each target.

interpretation_boundary: Stage38 is a post-hoc objective-development study using only frozen MK14 and PPARG training rows. Its scaffold holdouts are internal development evidence, not independent protein validation. A pass would authorize exact HUBO-to-QUBO quadratization and coefficient-range auditing only. It cannot authorize quantum hardware, claim quantum advantage, start new docking, change prior confirmation failures, or justify further tuning of these frozen weights after outcome inspection.
